name: Yang-ti
bio: Yang-ti was emperor of the Sui dynasty from AD 605 to 617. Waley gives one four-line poem of his, on the spring river by moonlight.
The poems here are Arthur Waley’s version in A Hundred and Seventy Chinese Poems (1918), given with the poet’s name as spelled in those books.

poems.title: Flowers and Moonlight on the Spring River
poems.author: Yang-ti
poems.collection: A Hundred and Seventy Chinese Poems (1918)
poems.text:
The evening river is level and motionless--
The spring colours just open to their full.
Suddenly a wave carries the moon away
And the tidal water comes with its freight of stars.
